title: Credential refresh has a last-consumer problem
method: Synthetic twenty-instance rotation: 15+4+1=20; refreshed by five minutes=19/20=95%. Groups are mutually exclusive. Overlap duration and revocation urgency are service-specific.
alt: Credential refresh has a last-consumer problem: Within one minute 15 instances, By five minutes 4 instances, Still stale 1 instances. Illustrative inputs.
